terra.problem: Saying nobody is bringing a treaty to sign adds a detail the passage does not give.
Edom soaring and nesting among the stars is conditional imagery. Saying Edom could keep climbing and go higher than the stars changes and extends it.
The text says thieves would steal only what they wanted, not that they would necessarily leave something behind.
Saying somebody will be digging assumes the hidden treasures are buried, which the text does not say.
The yard-sale joke makes light of the pillaging.
Eating Edom's bread does not establish that these people shared a table with Edom.
The shared table and the trap coming at the end of a meal add details the text does not give.
The text does not say the mighty men are the strongest people, that everyone counts on them, or that they are shaking.
The text says the mighty men will be terrified. It does not say whether they stand firm or whether their strength helps them.
Being terrified does not establish that fighters cannot win. The passage does not state that conclusion.
Saying the family relationship makes the hurt go deeper adds an unmarked claim about the hurt.
The text does not say the fugitives were heading toward a crossroads.
Saying the fugitives should not have found Edom in their way implies it happened. The verse says Edom should not stand at the crossroads, without stating that it did.
